advisory.detail: Block damage ordering derived from 6x may not hold at 3x. Fixed order is correct for controlled comparison, but log single-block deltas per ratio and check rank correlation. Costs no extra compute.

W_down at 3x has 2x more parameters than 6x; 500 Adam steps may leave 3x less converged, inflating c_3x. Conservative bias (against confirmation). Log final polish loss per ratio for post-hoc convergence check.

notes: 6x replication serves as built-in sanity check against cycle 089 (c~0.41).
Cost estimate 15-20 min is slightly optimistic; 20-25 min more realistic given 72 polishes.
Monotonicity check (c_3x <= c_4x <= c_6x) is a good self-diagnostic.
